title: Gatekeeper probe: a hand-made zip opens on macOS 26 with Open Anyway
body: Early check for R-2, before PR-2's 7.5 h: zip the --release build from S-3, send it to a Mac on macOS 26 through a browser download (so it is quarantined), and open it. If there is no Open Anyway, the plan stops for Jordan.
done_when: the downloaded zip's app opens after System Settings → Privacy and Security → Open Anyway
